item.title: RTX's Collins Aerospace to expand Iowa plant that makes engine components
item.description: RTX said on Tuesday that its aerospace and defense systems unit, Collins Aerospace, will expand its aircraft engine components facility in West Des Moines, Iowa, by 14,000 square feet to increase manufacturing capacity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RTX (RTX.N) said on Tuesday that its aerospace and defense systems unit, Collins Aerospace, will expand its aircraft engine components facility in West Des Moines, Iowa, by 14,000 square feet to increase manufacturing capacity. RTX said it would make a multi-million-dollar investment in the plant to meet rising customer demand. It did not disclose the exact figure The West Des Moines facility produces fuel distribution systems and engine nozzle components for commercial and military aircraft. It ships more than 25,000 engine nozzles a month The site employs about 300 full-time workers. The company plans to add more jobs by the end of the year and continue hiring into 2027 Construction is scheduled to begin later this month and completion is expected by the middle of next year Collins Aerospace completed a $14 million, 9,000-square-foot expansion of another West Des Moines facility in 2023 to increase manufacturing capacity with metal 3D printers The Arlington, Virginia-based RTX makes aircraft engines, missile systems and air-defense technologies for commercial and military customers

item.title: Rooney opposes stripping Man City's league titles over financial breaches
item.description: Wayne Rooney does not want Manchester City to be stripped of the 2011-12 Premier League title as punishment for their breaches of the competition's financial rules, believing it would be unfair for the players and staff who worked hard to win the league.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Wayne Rooney does not want Manchester City to be stripped of the 2011-12 Premier League title as punishment for their breaches of the competition's financial rules, believing it would be unfair for the players and staff who worked hard to win the league. Rooney was in the Manchester United squad that lost out by goal difference as City won their first English top-flight title in over four decades with a [USN:BRE84D0BS TEXT:"stoppage-time comeback"]. But after City were [USN:L1N45H0FI TEXT:"found guilty"] on 114 of 115 charges, they are [USN:L6N45K0U6 TEXT:"facing severe potential sanctions"] including relegation and loss of titles, although enforcement is far off with the club expected to appeal. City have consistently denied wrongdoing. Rooney's former teammates Rio Ferdinand and David de Gea suggested they should be awarded the retrospective title in social media posts, but Rooney told the "Stick to United" podcast that United did not earn it. "I wouldn't feel comfortable about accepting another Premier League medal if I'm being honest, because I don't think we deserve it. We didn't do enough that season to win the league," Rooney said in an interview released on Tuesday. "I'm thinking as their players, they're there doing everything they can to win the Premier League title and in their minds they've done it. "And, if those players have got no understanding of what's going on above them, then if that happened to me, if all of a sudden Manchester United have been doing the same and I'm getting my Premier League medals taken away from me, I'd be absolutely devastated." The former England forward, however, was in favour of City receiving a harsh punishment, including relegation and financial restrictions. "I'd put them in the lowest league they can go in and then put restrictions on them in terms of how much money they can spend for the next three or four seasons," he said.

item.title: Congo to Audit Major Miners Annually From 2027 as Part of Local Content Drive, Regulator Says
item.description: By Ange Kasongo The Democratic Republic of Congo will subject major mining companies to annual audits of subcontracting practices and compliance with local-content requirements from 2027, as authorities step up efforts to increase business for Congolese-owned firms, the head of the country’s subcontracting regulator told …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Ange Kasongo

The Democratic Republic of Congo will subject major mining companies to annual audits of subcontracting practices and compliance with local-content requirements from 2027, as authorities step up efforts to increase business for Congolese-owned firms, the head of the country’s subcontracting regulator told Reuters.

The world’s largest cobalt producer and Africa’s top copper producer has tightened oversight of its mining sector as it seeks to channel more contracts and procurement spending to local companies.

A new local-content law is due to take effect on January 1, 2027. Authorities are drafting sector-specific rules for mining and other industries that will include sanctions and mandatory three-year compliance plans, Beleshayi Kasanda Ted, director general of the Authority for the Regulation of Subcontracting in the Private Sector (ARSP), told Reuters last week.

Major operators in Congo include Ivanhoe Mines, Glencore, Eurasian Resources Group and China’s CMOC, and Zijin.

Regulator Expands Inspection Capacity

ARSP this month ordered Glencore, Ivanhoe’s Kipushi zinc mine and Chinese-controlled copper miner Sicomines to end non-compliant subcontracting arrangements, submit corrective plans and expand opportunities for Congolese-owned suppliers.

An Ivanhoe spokesperson said the company was in regular contact with ARSP and considered its Kipushi mine compliant with applicable subcontracting rules.

Glencore declined to comment. Sicomines did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Beleshayi said ARSP was recruiting a new group of inspectors and reviewing previously unresolved company inspections as part of a broader compliance drive.

Robert Malumba Kalombo, head of the Federation of Enterprises of Congo, the country’s largest private-sector business association, warned implementation risked becoming too focused on inspections and penalties rather than helping build competitive Congolese companies.

Jean-Claude Mputu, spokesperson for nonprofit group Congo Is Not for Sale, called for greater transparency around enforcement actions and disclosure of subcontractors’ beneficial owners.

He warned stricter local-content requirements could encourage politically connected firms to capture contracts without stronger safeguards.

Of the $3.7 billion in subcontracting contracts declared by 167 major companies in 2025, $3.1 billion, or 83%, went to majority Congolese-owned companies, including $2.9 billion in the mining sector alone, Beleshayi said.

item.title: Netflix cae 26% y se ubica entre las 50 acciones de peor desempeño del S&P 500
item.description: Las rebajas de recomendación de HSBC y Wells Fargo reflejan una creciente preocupación por el crecimiento de Netflix, mientras la falta de grandes éxitos y la competencia presionan sus acciones.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Vlastelica
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El apoyo alcista de Wall Street a Netflix Inc. ( NFLX ) está empezando a resquebrajarse, ya que la acción va camino de registrar su peor año desde 2022, en medio de crecientes preocupaciones sobre su crecimiento. HSBC rebajó la semana pasada su calificación del gigante del streaming a “mantener”, alegando indicios de un debilitamiento del compromiso de los suscriptores. Esta decisión se produjo tras la rebaja de Wells Fargo ( WFC ) a principios de este mes, que señaló la falta de series de éxito y otorgó a Netflix su primera calificación equivalente a “vender” en meses. Ver más: Netflix sufre segunda rebaja de recomendación en una semana por presión de YouTube y falta de éxitos El repunte de las acciones registrado en agosto se ha visto frustrado, lo que deja a Netflix con una caída del 26% en lo que va de año y entre las 50 empresas con peor rendimiento del índice S&P 500 en 2026. De los 65 analistas que cubren la acción, 48 mantienen ahora recomendaciones de “comprar”, la cifra más baja desde marzo, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg. “Netflix se ha convertido en un caso en el que hay que demostrar lo que vale, ya que no está dando la talla a la hora de ofrecer auténticos éxitos de taquilla, series del tipo que se sitúan entre las 100 mejores, algo que hay que solucionar a toda prisa”, afirmó Eric Clark, director de inversiones de Accuvest Global Advisors, que posee acciones de la empresa pero ha estado reduciendo su posición. “Para solucionar el problema de la retención de los espectadores, hay que ofrecer a la gente contenidos de los que merezca la pena hablar, y empieza a parecer que hay un problema de creatividad, ya que, aunque podría decirse que Netflix es la que más dinero tiene para invertir, son las demás plataformas de streaming las que están consiguiendo las series de moda”, señaló Clark. Netflix cuenta con más suscriptores que cualquier otro servicio de streaming de pago, pero mantener a los espectadores pegados a sus pantallas es cada vez más importante, sobre todo ahora que la empresa está desarrollando su negocio publicitario en un contexto de creciente competencia. Ofrecer un flujo constante de éxitos es fundamental para la retención de los espectadores, razón por la cual la percepción de que Netflix ha carecido de títulos destacados este año ha lastrado tanto a las acciones. Ver más: Netflix ha aportado más de MXN$50.000 millones al PIB de México en 15 años Las acciones se han desplomado un 48% desde el máximo alcanzado en junio de 2025. Incluso las series de Netflix que han tenido buena acogida han tenido dificultades para mantener su audiencia más allá de la primera temporada, según informó Bloomberg News en julio. El intento de la empresa de adquirir Warner Bros Discovery Inc. ( WBD ), que abandonó a principios de este año, fue interpretado por algunos inversores como una falta de confianza en su capacidad para crecer de forma orgánica. Un portavoz de Netflix se negó a hacer comentarios. La escasez de éxitos de taquilla de Netflix contrasta con servicios de streaming más pequeños, como el de Apple Inc. ( AAPL ), que dominaron los premios Emmy de este año, o con el resurgimiento de la asistencia a las salas de cine, impulsado por grandes éxitos como Obsession , Spider-Man: Brand New Day y The Odyssey. L as cadenas de cines AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc. ( AMC ), Cinemark Holdings Inc. ( CNK ) e IMAX Corp. ( IMAX ) han visto cómo sus acciones se disparaban más del 50% este año, superando con creces las subidas del S&P 500 y del Nasdaq 100, que se situaron en el 12% y el 20%, respectivamente. Sin embargo, el mayor rival de Netflix en cuanto a espectadores es YouTube, de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), cuya cuota en el mercado televisivo estadounidense alcanzó un máximo histórico del 14,2% en julio, según Bloomberg Intelligence, que utilizó los datos mensuales más recientes de Nielsen. La cuota de Netflix cayó por debajo del 8%. Ver más: Netflix busca duplicar sus ingresos por publicidad en 2026 y apuesta por América Latina Las ganancias de YouTube “se producen cada vez más a expensas directas de Netflix”, escribió el analista de HSBC Mohammed Khallouf en su revisión a la baja del 22 de septiembre. Atribuyó esta tendencia a “una menor acogida del contenido original de NFLX” y añadió que “parece poco probable una recuperación a corto plazo de la participación de los usuarios”. Por supuesto, Netflix cuenta con un largo historial de títulos populares y algunos de sus mayores éxitos parecieron surgir de la nada, como KPop Demon Hunters , Adolescence y Squid Game . Además, tiene previstos algunos estrenos de gran repercusión. Las nuevas desventuras de Cliff Booth , secuela de Érase una vez en Hollywood , protagonizada por Brad Pitt, estará disponible para los suscriptores en diciembre. La próxima cita para conocer los resultados financieros de Netflix tendrá lugar el 20 de octubre, cuando la empresa con sede en Los Gatos (California) publique sus resultados del tercer trimestre. Wall Street prevé un crecimiento de los ingresos de casi el 12%, lo que supondría la expansión más lenta desde 2023, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg. Se espera que el beneficio neto aumente un 36%, frente al crecimiento del 8% registrado hace un año. A pesar de que se prevé una desaceleración de la expansión de Netflix, muchos inversores siguen mostrándose optimistas respecto al potencial a largo plazo de la acción. Parte del motivo radica en su valoración, que se encuentra muy a la baja. Con un perímetro de aproximadamente 19 veces los beneficios estimados, las acciones de Netflix cotizan con un descuento de más del 60% respecto a su media de los últimos diez años, que se sitúa en casi 50 veces. “No creo que las preocupaciones sobre la competencia sean exageradas, ya que todos luchan por la próxima cuota de mercado, pero Netflix cuenta con un historial probado a la hora de encontrar éxitos y adentrarse en nuevas áreas de crecimiento como los deportes, los podcasts y los videojuegos”, afirmó Gerald Sparrow, director de inversiones del Sparrow Growth Fund, que posee acciones de la empresa. Ver más: Del documental de ‘El Canelo’ a Keiko: estos son los proyectos con los que Netflix celebra 15 años en México “El crecimiento y la valoración siguen pareciendo atractivos, y el equipo directivo ha sido capaz de salir de situaciones de incertidumbre como esta en el pasado. Puede que no sea este trimestre, pero creo que, dentro de un año, recordaremos estos precios como una oportunidad”. --Con la colaboración de Carmen Reinicke y Henry Ren. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: BNP Paribas et la BEI mettent €700 mlns de garanties à disposition des réseaux énergétiques européens
item.description: BNP Paribas et la Banque européenne d'investissement (BEI) ont annoncé mardi mettre 700 millions d'euros de garanties à disposition des réseaux énergétiques européens, afin de soutenir leur transition énergétique, renforcer la compétitivité industrielle et sécuriser l'approvisionnement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) et la Banque européenne d'investissement (BEI) ont annoncé mardi mettre 700 millions d'euros de garanties à disposition des réseaux énergétiques européens, afin de soutenir leur transition énergétique, renforcer la compétitivité industrielle et sécuriser l'approvisionnement. "Cette opération de partage de risque vise à accroître la capacité de BNP Paribas à s'engager en faveur des fabricants européens de composants pour les réseaux électriques et à leur permettre de répondre à la forte demande générée par la transition énergétique", déclare le groupe dans un communiqué. La BEI s'engage à rendre disponible 350 millions d'euros de garantie pour constituer un portefeuille de financements destinés aux fabricants de composants pour les réseaux, selon le communiqué, BNP Paribas s'engageant pour un montant équivalent. D'après la banque française, "l'effet de levier généré par cette contre-garantie devrait stimuler jusqu'à 2,8 milliards d'euros d'investissements dans l'économie réelle".

item.content:encoded:

Working paper backs independent auditors inside AI labs; OpenAI, Anthropic leaders among authors

A Cambridge working paper co-authored by senior AI figures calls for independent auditors inside AI labs, limits on the pace of AI progress and plans to pause AI research at data centres.

Vrinda Tulsian

29 September, 2026 07:45 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

OpenAI and Anthropic logos in illustration dated 11 June, 2026 | Dado Ruvic/Reuters

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

New Delhi: Senior scientists from OpenAI and Anthropic, the two leading companies of the AI race, have backed proposals that governments place independent auditors inside AI companies, set limits on how fast AI capabilities can advance, and develop a mechanism to pause AI research workloads at data centres.

The proposals appear in a working paper released this month by the University of Cambridge’s Programme on AI Science & Policy (CASP). Its 22 authors include OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki, Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark, Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton, Turing Award winner Yoshua Bengio and Microsoft’s Eric Horvitz.

The paper argues that AI companies are approaching the point where they could automate their own research, potentially triggering an “intelligence explosion” which it defines as “a dramatic AI-driven acceleration of AI progress, compressing advances that would otherwise take years into months or less”.

Show Full Article

“Because progress during an intelligence explosion would outpace normal policymaking, preparations must be made in advance,” the authors write.

The paper notes that the authors’ views “do not necessarily represent the views of the organisations with which they are affiliated”.

Also Read: No training for AI models without risk assessment & senior leadership’s nod, says OpenAI

Auditors, limits and emergency brakes The working paper asks governments to consider “limits on the extent to which capabilities can increase within a given time period,” and to require safety measures before companies can continue developing or deploying systems.

It calls for oversight of data centres used for automated AI research, and for incident-response procedures developed with data centre operators and AI companies, “such as developing options to pause specific AI R&D workloads”.

It proposes that independent third parties, such as accredited auditors or government bodies, evaluate AI systems before companies deploy them internally, or be “embedded within certain AI companies to audit or supervise their R&D activities.” The authors point to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission, which places resident inspectors at nuclear plants, and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, which supervises banks, as models.

The paper also calls for mandatory reporting of how far companies have automated their research, how those systems are overseen, and incidents involving internal AI systems. It says existing laws, including California’s SB 53, New York’s RAISE Act and the EU’s general-purpose AI code of practice, “either do not adequately cover internal AI R&D use cases or do not specify indicators to be reported”.

Internationally, the authors propose confidence-building measures, agreements to prevent “destabilizing development and use of highly capable AI systems,” and war games simulating an intelligence explosion. They ask countries to clarify “whether and how they would deter another actor from scale-ups of automated AI R&D”.

The authors flag a risk in their own proposals. “Poorly crafted mechanisms could allow a government to slow R&D at all but a favored company,” they write.

Race towards automated AI research The paper sets out why the authors believe action is needed now. Citing Anthropic data, it says AI’s share of approved code at the company rose from “low single digits” in January 2025 to over 80 percent by May 2026. The share of research work AI completed “with only high-level human supervision” rose from 1 percent to 26 percent between March and August 2026.

“AI systems are on track to automate most AI R&D work within a few years, and possibly all of it,” the paper states.

The authors estimate that once AI reaches expert-level research ability at current running costs, the computing power held by a single frontier company “could sustain an AI workforce equivalent to at least millions of top human researchers.” Frontier companies currently employ thousands. The paper’s calculations put OpenAI’s capacity at about 20 million researcher-equivalents, within a range of 2 million to 200 million.

Using historical data, the paper estimates that after full automation, AI progress could accelerate tenfold within about 1.5 years, at which point “a year’s worth of progress at today’s pace would take about five weeks”. Extrapolating current trends, it says AI could automate “months-long AI R&D projects” by mid-2028.

The limits of human oversight The authors identify three risks: capabilities could grow faster than society can respond; humans could lose control of AI systems, which the paper says “have become harder to oversee”; and checks on power could be eroded, with a state able to turn “a modest lead in military R&D or operations into a decisive one”.

On control, the paper warns that as humans step back from research, “they could lose both the opportunities and expertise needed to identify and fix problems.” At the extreme, it says, loss of control could lead to “the marginalization or extinction of humanity.”

The authors describe the evidence as “preliminary” and “mixed”. Diminishing returns, limits on computing power and data, tasks that are hard to automate, and training runs that take three months or more could slow progress.

The paper records that current systems “sometimes disobey instructions, cheat on tasks, misrepresent their work,” and that GPT-6 fails some OpenAI debugging tasks that human researchers can complete.

“Productivity gains from AI R&D automation have not yet reached the threshold needed to trigger an intelligence explosion,” the authors write. Gains from newer systems, they add, “are likely approaching that threshold.”

“Relative to the stakes, we are not sufficiently prepared,” the paper concludes. “Once an intelligence explosion begins, the window for action may close.”

(Edited by Harini TS)

item.title: ロシア特使が訪米、ウクライナ和平や戦後の米ロエネルギー協力協議＝米当局者
item.description: [ワシントン ２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２９日　ロイター] - ロシアのドミトリエフ大統領特別代表は２８日に訪問先の米国で米政府当局者と会談し、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争の平和的な解決のほか、戦争終結後の米ロのエネルギー分野での取り組みの可能性などについて協議した。米当局者が２９日、明らかにした。協議は「建設的」だったとしている。

ドミトリエフ氏はロシア政府系ファンド「ロシア直接投資基金（ＲＤＩＦ）」の総裁を務めている。今回の訪米はトランプ米大統領とウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が先週ニューヨークで会談した後に実現した。ゼレンスキー氏は会談後、エネルギー関連施設を対象とする停戦の可能性について協議したと明らかにしていた。

米当局者は、ドミトリエフ氏は「ロシア・ウクライナ戦争の平和的解決、戦争終結後の米ロのエネルギー分野における取り組みの可能性について、建設的な協議を継続するため」ワシントンを訪問したと説明。複数の関係筋によると、ドミトリエフ氏はワシントン滞在中に財務省のほか、エネルギー省の関係者と会談した。

今月初めには、米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使とトランプ米大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏がロシアを訪問し、モスクワでプーチン大統領と会談している。

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street sur de timides variations, la "tech" en soutien
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert sur de faibles variations mardi, le rebond des valeurs technologiques offrant un peu de soutien sur un marché prudent alors que le conflit au Moyen-Orient, les niveaux élevés des cours pétroliers et des rendements obligataires limitent l'appétit pour le risque.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert sur de faibles variations mardi, le rebond des valeurs technologiques offrant un peu de soutien sur un marché prudent alors que le conflit au Moyen-Orient, les niveaux élevés des cours pétroliers et des rendements obligataires limitent l'appétit pour le risque. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) perd 44,23 points, soit 0,09%, à 51.437,28 points. Le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, monte de 8,67 points, soit 0,11%, à 7.692,36 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) progresse de 84,22 points, soit 0,31%, à 26.904,60 points. Le compartiment technologique (.SPLRCT) est au centre de l'attention, le prospectus d'introduction en Bourse (IPO) d'[USN:L6N45L01F TEXT:"Anthropic"], consulté par Reuters, ayant montré une forte croissance du spécialiste de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) sur l'année écoulée. Anthropic vise une valorisation de plus de 2.000 milliards de dollars pour son IPO, ce qui pourrait servir de mètre-étalon au secteur. "Le marché se trouve actuellement dans une phase d'observation. La croissance des bénéfices a été phénoménale, mais les attentes sont extrêmement élevées et une grande partie des bonnes nouvelles sont déjà intégrées au cours des actions", note Newton Jones, directeur général exécutif du groupe Zizmer-Jones Private Wealth Management. Les groupes liés aux semi-conducteurs comme Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) , Micron Technology (MU.O) et Broadcom (AVGO.O) avancent de 1,88% à 2,82% après de fortes baisses la veille. Le secteur des puces (.SOX) s'adjuge 1,66%. Nvidia (NVDA.O) , qui a pris 1,68% lundi, monte encore, de 1,42%, restant sur la lancée positive de la veille après que le spécialiste des puces a dévoilé un programme de rachat d'actions record de 150 milliards de dollars. Dans les indicateurs américains du jour susceptibles d'influer sur la tendance figurent l'enquête JOLTS sur les offres d'emplois, prélude au rapport mensuel officiel sur l'emploi, prévu vendredi, ainsi qu'un indice mesurant la confiance du consommateur pour le mois de septembre. Ces données sont importantes alors que la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed), à l'initiative de son nouveau président Kevin Warsh, a opté pour une réduction de sa communication sur ses orientations prospectives. Selon le baromètre CME FedWatch, les opérateurs tablent actuellement avec une probabilité de 70% la probabilité sur une nouvelle hausse des taux de la Fed en octobre. Au moins six responsables de la banque centrale américaine, dont le président de la Fed de New York, John Williams, doivent s'exprimer ce mardi. Pour le moment, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans recule de 1,4 point de base, à 5,229%, après cinq séances consécutives de gains, ce qui soulage le marché actions. Les cours pétroliers refluent également, aidés par des signes d'une reprise des exportations de brut en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Le Brent et le WTI devraient toutefois enregistrer des gains mensuels d'environ 16% et 7% respectivement. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N45L0QY]

item.title: 米消費者信頼感が急低下、2014年以来の低水準－景気悲観強まる
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 9月の米消費者信頼感指数は前月比で低下し、2014年以来の水準に落ち込んだ。景気や労働市場に対する悲観が強まった。
現況指数は8ポイント近く下げて、2021年以来の低水準。今後6カ月の見通しを示す期待指数は約1年ぶりの水準に低下した。
今回の統計はガソリン価格の高止まりなど、物価高を巡る消費者の根強い不安を浮き彫りにしている。インフレへの懸念はあるものの、個人消費と労働市場は底堅さを維持している。10月2日発表の9月の米雇用統計では、雇用者数の堅調な伸びが引き続き示される見通しだ。
イランでの戦争を受けて、ガソリン価格は1ガロン＝4ドルを一貫して上回っていることが全米自動車協会（AAA）のデータで示されている。米国の小売りディーゼル価格は過去最高に近い水準にあるほか、冬を前に暖房油の価格も上昇している。
原題：US Consumer Confidence Plunges to Lowest

item.title: Falha no motor da Starship pode afetar objetivos da missão lunar da Nasa
item.description: A falha no motor da Starship, que quase impediu a estreia orbital da espaçonave de última geração da SpaceX em seu 14º voo de teste não tripulado, pode dificultar a capacidade da Nasa de cumprir seu cronograma para missões de astronautas à Lua.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman, Akash Sriram, Joey Roulette
item.content:encoded: A falha no motor da Starship, que quase impediu a estreia orbital da espaçonave de última geração da SpaceX em seu 14º voo de teste não tripulado, pode dificultar a capacidade da Nasa de cumprir seu cronograma para missões de astronautas à Lua. A Starship, projetada em parte para transportar grandes cargas úteis ao espaço, é uma das duas naves que disputam o título de primeira nave que a Nasa utilizará já em 2028 para levar seres humanos à Lua e trazê-los de volta em segurança, um feito alcançado pela última vez em 1972, no final da era Apollo. Embora a Starship tenha cumprido vários objetivos-chave em seu último lançamento de teste, realizado na segunda-feira no Texas, a missão foi encurtada em várias horas devido a uma falha em seu sistema de propulsão. Apesar da desativação inesperada de um de seus três motores Raptor principais após a separação da Starship do foguete impulsionador do estágio inferior, os controladores de voo prosseguiram com o envio da espaçonave à órbita para seu primeiro lançamento comercial de satélite. Determinar o que causou a falha no motor continua sendo fundamental para os resultados financeiros da SpaceX. Mas os riscos são potencialmente maiores para a Nasa, já que um veículo de pouso lunar da Starship dependeria do mesmo sistema de propulsão para transportar astronautas pelo espaço de e para a superfície lunar. O quanto essa falha no motor representará um revés para o progresso do desenvolvimento da Starship depende se ela for “uma falha pontual de uma única peça” ou se apontar para um problema de projeto mais amplo que exija atualizações “em toda a frota”, disse Dean Sladen, engenheiro aeroespacial da Accu Components. “Qualquer reparo no motor que atrase os próximos voos, incluindo a tentativa planejada de capturar a nave com os braços da torre de lançamento (após a reentrada), prejudica esse cronograma”, disse ele. A Nasa e a SpaceX não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário da Reuters. Um atraso mais prolongado representaria não apenas um revés maior para as ambições comerciais da SpaceX de expandir rapidamente sua rede de satélites de banda larga Starlink, mas também para seu papel fundamental no programa lunar Artemis da Nasa. “A verdadeira pressão é a Lua. A Nasa precisa da Starship para a Artemis 3”, disse Sladen, referindo-se a uma missão de teste em órbita terrestre prevista para já no próximo verão (no Hemisfério Norte) como um voo de ensaio para o primeiro pouso lunar tripulado do programa. Problemas com o motor Raptor e o sistema de propulsão contribuíram para vários contratempos anteriores da Starship, incluindo um motor que não acendeu conforme planejado durante o 12º voo da Starship, em maio. Os motores movidos a metano estão entre os componentes mais complexos e caros do foguete. Durante alguns voos anteriores, a SpaceX cancelou os planos de testar a ignição do motor Raptor no espaço. Mas todos os motores foram acionados com sucesso durante a ascensão no 13º voo da Starship, em julho. A SpaceX (SPCX.O) , empresa fundada por Elon Musk perto de Los Angeles em 2002 e que recentemente abriu seu capital, está competindo com a Blue Origin, empresa rival de foguetes do também empresário Jeff Bezos, para inaugurar uma era de exploração lunar no âmbito do programa Artemis da Nasa. Embora a SpaceX tenha sido originalmente contratada para fornecer o primeiro módulo de pouso lunar tripulado para o Artemis, o chefe da agência espacial dos EUA, Jared Isaacman, afirmou em abril que a Nasa optaria pelo módulo que estivesse pronto para voar primeiro. A Nasa considerou essa concorrência adicional saudável para o progresso, tendo em vista os crescentes atrasos no programa de voos de teste da Starship. A Nasa tem como meta oficial levar astronautas de volta à superfície da Lua até 2028 — uma meta amplamente considerada excessivamente ambiciosa — para chegar lá antes da China, que planeja um pouso tripulado na Lua até 2030. (Reportagem de Steve Gorman, em Los Angeles, e Akash Sriram, em Bengaluru; Reportagem adicional de Joey Roulette, em Washington)

item.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus sharpens focus on AI valuations
item.description: Anthropic is betting that AI will reshape the global economy more profoundly than industrialization, electricity and the internet, according to its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic is betting that AI will reshape the global economy more profoundly than industrialization, electricity and the internet, according to its [USN:L6N45L01L TEXT:"IPO prospectus"] seen by Reuters. The AI lab, which could be valued at more than $2 trillion in its IPO, plans to spend $518 billion on cloud computing and infrastructure obligations in the coming years, according to the prospectus. European tech shares (.SX8P) jumped 2.4%, while U.S. chip index (.SOX) climbed 1.5%. Here are some comments from analysts on Anthropic's reported financials: SUSANNAH STREETER, CHIEF INVESTMENT STRATEGIST, WEALTH CLUB, LONDON "It's the vision and the projections to the extent to which Anthropic believes AI will be a game changer for economies around the world that seem to have lifted demand for European tech stocks." "There still will be niggles of concern among some about the huge sums that are projected to be spent even though it is making a loss. But that hasn't caused a flutter of general fear because, overall, there still seems to be a pretty hefty appetite for AI focused investments." MICHAEL FIELD, CHIEF EQUITY STRATEGIST, MORNINGSTAR, AMSTERDAM "If anything, the acceleration of the business is the biggest part of this release. Growing a big business can be difficult, but the prospectus stating that revenue grew by 12 fold in 2025 is truly remarkable." "Obviously a $2 trillion valuation sounds outlandish, but when you break it down to a multiple of sales, likely to be around 18-20x, it sounds much more reasonable than the recent SpaceX IPO." "The losses certainly are a concern. Particularly given the growth rate and the size relative to current revenues. It's unlikely to deter investors, however, with the spend story having been digested for some time now." "The key takeaway for investors is the confidence in the business and the AI strategy. Yes spend is high and growing, but management obviously feel the growth rate inherent in demand is sufficiently attractive to keep spending, hence why they are coming to market and demanding a top-dollar valuation." DAN COATSWORTH, HEAD OF MARKETS, AJ BELL, LONDON "Massive spending would normally have investors running for the hills, but what's capturing the market's attention is Anthropic's stellar revenue growth, up 12-fold in 2025. Admittedly, AI is moving at such a rapid pace that last year’s sales achievements relate to technology that is already outdated." "However, nearly one quarter of last year's revenue reportedly came from two customers, implying concentration risks. Investors will be hoping that it broadens its client base quickly." KATHLEEN BROOKS, RESEARCH DIRECTOR, XTB PLATFORM, LONDON "This is positive for the AI trade, since it is fuelled by continued elevated levels of capex spend. The fact that Anthropic is planning on spending big on capex means that the capex cycle is not over yet. This is good news for semiconductor and AI infrastructure companies. I believe that if Anthropic had signalled a lower level of spending, this could have caused a wobble in the AI trade, since it would lead to fears about the sustainability of the AI trade as we move into Q4." NEWTON JONES, WEALTH MANAGER, ZIZMER-JONES PRIVATE WEALTH MANAGEMENT GROUP AT STEWARD PARTNERS, WINTER PARK, FLORIDA "There are a lot of question marks around these valuations. It's hard for me to get my arms around companies that are losing billions of dollars, require massive capital expenditure and are looking at equity values of more than $2 trillion." "When you have this much money being thrown at a sector, it is driving valuations based on optimism and on what could go right. The annual recurring revenue opportunity investors see in the future is what's underpinning these valuations."

item.title: New Mexico launches quantum hub to bring together private firms with US national labs
item.description: New Mexico officials on Tuesday launched a shared quantum computing research facility to bring together the two US national labs in the state with private companies.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: New Mexico officials on Tuesday launched a shared quantum computing research facility to bring together the two US national labs in the state with private companies. The Roadrunner Quantum Lab, as it is called, is a 35,000-square-foot (3,252-square-meter) facility in Albuquerque, New Mexico, that will have features such as concrete floors several feet thick and dilution refrigerators, cryogenic cooling units that keep quantum computers so cold that atoms barely move. The outpost is the first concrete step in an effort to [USN:L6N3UL0U7 TEXT:"direct hundreds of millions of dollars into"][USN:L6N3UL0U7 TEXT:" quantum computing"], which could help solve problems that would take conventional computers thousands of years. Two of the initial tenants will be Sandia and Los Alamos National Labs, two of the three US labs that develop and maintain the nation's nuclear weapons arsenal. The labs will provide independent scientific expertise and set up a Quantum Demonstration Facility to help the private firms in the facility build and evaluate quantum systems. "The idea is to help take technology we've done at the labs, and help them commercialize and become successful companies," Rob Black, the secretary of economic development for New Mexico, said in an interview. "That's how we scale to ensure the US leads in these very important technologies." The private companies at the facility will include Diraq, IonQ (IONQ.N) , Quantum Machines, Conductor Quantum, Mesa Quantum, QBoltz, Photon Queue and QuEra. Adam Hammer, CEO of Roadrunner Venture Studios, which received state funding to lead the effort around the facility, said it was in part inspired by Taiwan's 1980s push to develop a semiconductor zone in Hsinchu County, which is now home to both Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330.TW) and United Microelectronics Corp (2303.TW) . "The Taiwanese government funded this three-mile industry zone where they put up a lot of the patient capital to create shared manufacturing facilities. And that birthed TSMC. It also birthed their biggest rival, UMC," Hammer said in an interview. "And it was a feature, not a bug, that they were building elbow to elbow."

item.title: Who is John Waldron, long seen as next Goldman CEO?
item.description: Goldman Sachs Group is reportedly laying the groundwork for a succession plan that would see President and Chief Operating Officer John Waldron succeed David Solomon as CEO as early as 2027 or 2028.
item.dc:creator: Pritam Biswas, Arasu Basil
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs Group (GS.N) is reportedly laying the groundwork for a [USN:L4N45K1NY TEXT:"succession plan"] that would see President and Chief Operating Officer John Waldron succeed David Solomon as CEO as early as 2027 or 2028. If finalized, the transition would crown a nearly three-decade career at the Wall Street giant for the 57-year-old executive, who has worked in lockstep with Solomon to engineer the firm's modern strategic direction. Here are key facts about Waldron’s life, career and role at the bank: EARLY LIFE AND EDUCATION Waldron was raised in Cleveland, Ohio, before his family relocated to Philadelphia when he was 15. He earned a Bachelor of Arts degree from Middlebury College in Vermont. A former youth athlete, Waldron often credits his early sports experiences for teaching him discipline, the value of constructive feedback, and the importance of methodically improving upon his weaknesses. CLIMBING THE WALL STREET LADDER Like Solomon, Waldron spent part of his early career at Bear Stearns. He joined Goldman Sachs in 2000, roughly a year after Solomon's arrival. In an interview recently, Waldron shared that Goldman Sachs had initially rejected him as he failed a financial modelling test due to weak mathametics and accounting skills. Waldron steadily advanced through Goldman's investment banking divisions. He served as co-head of leveraged finance and held several positions of increasing seniority between 2000 to 2007, followed by a stint as global co-head of the financial sponsors group from 2007 to 2009. He served as global head of investment banking services and client coverage from 2009 to 2014, when he was promoted to co-head of the investment banking division, a role he held until October 2018. SOLOMON-WALDRON ERA Waldron's career trajectory has closely mirrored Solomon's. In October 2018, the exact month Solomon was named CEO, Waldron was elevated to president and chief operating officer at Goldman Sachs. In January 2025, both executives were awarded massive $80 million retention bonuses in restricted stock. The following month, Waldron was officially added to Goldman Sachs' board of directors, a move analysts viewed as cementing his status as the heir apparent. The move came a few months after he was reportedly approached by alternative asset manager Apollo, which he declined. Industry analysts have also noted that Waldron and Solomon have driven Goldman's current priorities together. Waldron is widely expected to maintain the strategy devised under Solomon rather than implement a radical pivot. KEY INITIATIVES AND LEADERSHIP STYLE As COO, Waldron has led execution priorities and operational efficiencies. Notably, he is credited with developing "OneGS 3.0", a long-term, AI-driven transformation plan introduced in late 2025. The initiative was designed to bolster the bank's resilience, productivity and profitability through automation, alongside capping headcount growth. He serves as co-chair of the firmwide enterprise risk committee, giving him broad oversight of Goldman's financial and nonfinancial risk management. Waldron is known for a disciplined, highly organized leadership style - famously color-coding his calendar to strictly separate business from family time - something he said in a conversation with BYU Marriott dean Brigitte Madrian. Waldron is married and has six kids. EXTERNAL EFFORTS Beyond Goldman, Waldron is chair of the International Advisory Board of the Atlantic Council and a member of the board of directors for the US-China Business Council. He also sits on the boards of the Cleveland Clinic, the Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts and the board of trustees at Middlebury College.

item.title: 'Let them be scared': Moscow sends EU message with widening corporate crackdown
item.description: Russia has singled out European firms in its latest drive to strip foreign owners of the right to manage their Russian assets, government and company sources said, with the Kremlin accusing the European Union of involvement in the war in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia has singled out European firms in its latest drive to strip foreign owners of the right to manage their Russian assets, government and company sources said, with the Kremlin accusing the European Union of involvement in the war in Ukraine . Russia [USN:L6N45K0RX TEXT:"placed"] the assets of Swiss food giant Nestle, German wholesaler Metro AG and French retailer Auchan under temporary management this month. "The time has come for asymmetric measures. Let them think about what measures they are taking and what sanctions they are introducing," a senior government source with direct knowledge of the measures told Reuters. Asked which companies might be the next targets and whether the Russian units of Italian bank UniCredit and Austrian lender Raiffeisen could be placed under temporary management, the source, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said: "Let them be scared." A Russian corporate source, who also spoke on condition of anonymity, accused European firms of deliberately stifling the development of their Russian units, ultimately harming the Russian economy. A senior manager with a European company, part of a shrinking community of foreign businesses operating in Russia, told Reuters that European businesses expected the status quo to be maintained in the immediate future. The Kremlin said on Tuesday the decisions were driven by "the increasing level of involvement of these unfriendly countries in direct battlefield hostilities" against Russia, but suggested the moves were "reversible". "For now, we do not see any grounds for a reversal. We do not hear any reasonable voices calling for dialogue or for efforts to rectify the situation," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters. The EU blames Russia for the failure to end the war, saying Moscow shows no real intent to engage in genuine peace talks, and last week [USN:L6N45F0S1 TEXT:"renewed sanctions"] on more than 3,000 individuals and entities. It did not immediately comment on Russia's latest moves against European companies. WAR WAGED BY EUROPE Peskov gave no evidence or details of how European countries were involved in military operations. Russian officials have previously cited weapons supplies, including the manufacture of drones in the EU, as well as the provision of targeting and intelligence information. "If you acknowledge that your weapons are being used against us, and we are shooting them down, call it whatever you want, but I have no doubt that this is a war being waged against us by Europe," Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said on Tuesday. Russia also criticises the EU for [USN:L6N3XO0R3 TEXT:"freezing"] about €210 billion ($238 billion) of its sovereign assets in response to the war and for targeting assets belonging to Russian companies in Europe and other Western countries. The EU, a staunch supporter of Ukraine during the more than 4-1/2-year-old war, has accused Russia of carrying out attacks on European territory, while some government and intelligence officials have raised the prospect of a future Russian invasion. Moscow has denied the accusations. Since the start of the war, Russia has introduced temporary administration at 135 firms affiliated with foreign companies, the vast majority of them from EU countries, including French food group Danone and Danish brewer Carlsberg, according to data compiled by Russian news agency TASS. Prior to the latest moves, Russian law firm NSP put the number of affected Western firms at 22. In its latest annual report, the Association of European Businesses said it had 330 member companies with operations in Russia, down from 400 a year earlier. No major US company has been targeted by similar measures, although some smaller firms, such as US private equity fund NCH Capital, whose Russian business includes agricultural assets, have also been [USN:L6N3YL0V9 TEXT:"placed"] under temporary administration. The American Chamber of Commerce in Russia put the number of US companies still operating in Russia at around 300 this year. Russia and the United States have been in discussions on business opportunities once peace is restored in Ukraine. ($1 = 0.8814 euros)

item.content:encoded:
世界的な長期金利上昇とエネ価格高止まりに警戒＝スペイン中銀総裁 9/29 23:06 配信

写真はエスクリバ・スペイン中銀総裁。2024年9月、マドリードで撮影。REUTERS/Susana Vera

[マドリード　２９日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのエスクリバ・スペイン中銀総裁は２９日、世界的な債券利回りの持続的な上昇とエネルギー価格の高止まりが、ＥＣＢ政策当局者にとっての主要な懸念材料であると述べた。

エスクリバ総裁は、金利は経済成長を抑制するほど高い水準には達していないと指摘。その上で、「世界的な長期金利の上昇トレンドを懸念し始めている」とし、利回り上昇が金利に上昇圧力をかける可能性があるほか、エネルギー価格の高止まりは危険な二次的インフレ効果を引き起こす恐れがあるとの見解を示した。

item.title: Florence Pugh diz que série “A Leste do Éden” revela lado humano de Cathy
item.description: Florence Pugh afirma que a nova adaptação de “A Leste do Éden” convida o público a ver Cathy, uma das vilãs mais notórias da literatura norte-americana, sob uma perspectiva mais compreensiva.
item.dc:creator: Francesca Halliwell
item.content:encoded: Florence Pugh afirma que a nova adaptação de “A Leste do Éden” convida o público a ver Cathy, uma das vilãs mais notórias da literatura norte-americana, sob uma perspectiva mais compreensiva. A atriz, que interpreta Cathy na minissérie de sete episódios, disse que a adaptação acrescenta contexto a uma personagem que o autor John Steinbeck descreveu famosamente como um “monstro psíquico” com uma “alma deformada”. “Ela ainda pode tomar decisões terríveis e enfrentar consequências horríveis, mas também pode haver... uma compreensão de sua história e de seu passado que a tornam do jeito que ela é”, disse a indicada ao Oscar. Escrita por Zoe Kazan, que coproduz a série ao lado de Jeb Stuart, a adaptação revisita a saga multigeracional de Steinbeck, com um foco renovado em Cathy. Kazan disse que a adaptação desafia os espectadores a enxergarem além das noções simplistas de bem e mal. “Queríamos que nosso público pudesse se identificar com cada personagem, tanto aqueles que parecem bons quanto aqueles que parecem maus”, disse ela. “Porque, se pensarmos nas pessoas que são más ou ruins como se não fossem humanas, não aprendemos nada sobre nós mesmos.” Kazan afirmou que sente uma profunda conexão com “A Leste do Éden” desde que leu o romance aos 15 anos, descrevendo-o como uma história que “me agarrou pela garganta e não me soltou” com sua exploração de como as pessoas carregam o passado de suas famílias para o futuro. Questionada se o foco do romance na herança e no acerto de contas com o passado ressoava pessoalmente nela, Kazan citou sua própria história familiar. Seu avô, o cineasta Elia Kazan, continua sendo uma figura controversa após ter denunciado ex-colegas ligados ao Partido Comunista perante uma comissão do Congresso durante a era McCarthy. Ele também dirigiu a adaptação do romance para o cinema em 1955, estrelada por James Dean. Descrevendo sua conexão com o material tanto como “fardo” quanto como “presente”, Kazan disse que espera que a série leve o público a refletir sobre suas próprias famílias, e não sobre a dela. “Não quero que ninguém saia daqui pensando: ‘Zoe Kazan, Elia Kazan’”, afirmou. “Queremos que as pessoas saiam daqui (pensando)... ‘Meu pai, meu filho, as coisas que eu fiz’.” Para Mike Faist, astro de “Rivais”, que interpreta Charles Trask na série, a história de Steinbeck perdurou porque reflete verdades fundamentais sobre a moralidade humana. “Voltamos a esses clássicos para... reexaminá-los, e isso é algo positivo”, disse ele. Stuart concordou com Faist, dizendo que os leitores podem voltar a “A Leste do Éden” ao longo de suas vidas e descobrir novos significados à medida que suas próprias experiências evoluem. “Perdi um filho adulto, então, mais tarde na vida... li o livro como se nunca tivesse lido ‘A Leste do Éden’ antes”, disse ele à Reuters. “Isso é o que há de mais legal na escrita de Steinbeck.” “A Leste do Éden” será lançada na Netflix na quinta-feira.

item.title: Geopark invertirá 7.000 millones de dólares para elevar la producción de campo petrolífero venezolano a 90.000 barriles diarios
item.description: La petrolera y gasífera colombiana Geopark planea una inversión de 7.000 millones de dólares en vasto yacimiento petrolífero venezolano de Bare para aumentar la producción de crudo allí a unos 90.000 barriles diarios (bpd) para el año 2038, frente a los 11.000 actuales, dijo el martes el director ejecutivo de la firma Felipe Bayón.
item.dc:creator: Deisy Buitrago
item.content:encoded: La petrolera y gasífera colombiana Geopark planea una inversión de 7.000 millones de dólares en vasto yacimiento petrolífero venezolano de Bare para aumentar la producción de crudo allí a unos 90.000 barriles diarios (bpd) para el año 2038, frente a los 11.000 actuales, dijo el martes el director ejecutivo de la firma Felipe Bayón. La compañía planea comenzar las operaciones en diciembre. Con un volumen total de petróleo in situ de 15.700 millones de barriles, Bare supondrá la entrada de GeoPark (GPRK.N) en Venezuela, tras la firma de un acuerdo de producción compartida a 25 años con el gobierno a principios de este mes. La empresa tiene previsto iniciar operaciones en la zona de la Faja del Orinoco en diciembre. "Es una inversión muy relevante" en términos de capital y gastos para maximizar la recuperación de la producción, afirmó Bayón el lunes durante la Cumbre Internacional de Petróleo y Gas de Venezuela (VIOGS) que se realiza en Caracas, añadiendo que se reactivarán hasta 1.100 pozos y que posteriormente podrían perforarse unos 80 nuevos pozos horizontales. Se espera que el inventario de pozos existentes y la infraestructura instalada en Bare permitan llevar a cabo un proyecto de desarrollo dividido en cuatro fases, agregó el ejecutivo. En un comunicado emitido a principios de este mes, GeoPark informó que disponía de unos 700 millones de dólares en liquidez y fuentes de financiación comprometidas para cubrir la inversión inicial, incluidos 310 millones de dólares en efectivo. La operación en Venezuela se financió con capital propio de GeoPark y se prevé que resulte en la adquisición indirecta del control de GeoPark por parte del Grupo Gilinski, de Colombia. GeoPark considera a Bare un paso clave en su estrategia regional a largo plazo, complementando sus proyectos en Colombia y Argentina. "Se espera que la incorporación de Bare y el aumento de la producción en Vaca Muerta (Argentina) incrementen potencialmente la producción de GeoPark hasta situarla entre 75.000 y 85.000 barriles equivalentes de petróleo diarios para 2030, lo que supone aproximadamente 2,7 veces los niveles de producción actuales", señaló la empresa en el comunicado.

item.title: Fake Mounjaro to unapproved retatrutide: Inside India's booming weight-loss drug black market
item.description: Fake Mounjaro, unapproved retatrutide and cheap weight-loss injections are entering India’s booming obesity drug market.
item.dc:creator: Sayantani Biswas
item.content:encoded: India’s weight-loss drug boom is fuelling a growing market for fake and unauthorised medicines. Counterfeit Mounjaro, heavily discounted injections and even unapproved obesity drugs are being offered to consumers, according to a Bloomberg News report.Among the products turning up in the market are fake versions of Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and unapproved retatrutide, the company’s next-generation obesity drug.Fake Mounjaro operation uncovered in GurugramThe investigation began after Amandeep Chauhan, a drug control officer in Haryana, noticed Mounjaro being advertised on IndiaMART at about 20% below its usual retail price of ₹13,125 for a month’s treatment, Bloomberg reported.Chauhan arranged to meet a seller in Gurugram. According to Bloomberg, investigators found three cartons of Mounjaro pens in a Maruti Suzuki sedan before tracing the operation to a rented two-bedroom apartment.The apartment contained injector pens, syringes, labels and packaging carrying Eli Lilly branding, as well as a refrigerator containing vials of peptides, Bloomberg reported.Chauhan arrested businessman Avi Sharma in April. Products seized during the raid were tested by Eli Lilly and found to be counterfeit. Several doses contained 30% or less of the labelled concentration of tirzepatide, the active ingredient in Mounjaro, according to Bloomberg.Why India's weight-loss drug market is vulnerableBloomberg reported that expensive branded obesity medicines have helped create demand for cheaper alternatives. Patients can find sellers through Telegram, WhatsApp, online marketplaces and other informal channels.The report also found that India's large pharmaceutical manufacturing ecosystem gives counterfeiters access to ingredients, packaging and other supplies. Regulators have previously identified falsified medicines linked to India’s supply chains, Bloomberg reported.Generic semaglutide complicates the marketIndia is also seeing a rapid expansion of generic semaglutide products following the expiry of Novo Nordisk’s patent for the active ingredient, Bloomberg reported.Nearly three dozen generic semaglutide brands have entered the market, including tablets, vials and injectable products, according to the report.Notably, Mounjaro remains patent-protected in India.Unapproved retatrutide appears in IndiaThe underground market has also reached experimental medicines. Bloomberg reported that investigators recovered retatrutide during the Gurugram raid.Retatrutide has not been approved for sale by any regulator and remains under clinical development. Yet, people familiar with the matter told Bloomberg that unofficial distributors had approached doctors, wellness centres and beauty clinics in Mumbai with offers to supply it.Listings for retatrutide have also appeared on IndiaMART and TradeIndia, Bloomberg reported.Eli Lilly told Bloomberg: "Retatrutide is an investigational medicine, available in Lilly's clinical trials, and has not been approved by any regulator anywhere in the world. No one can legally sell it for human use."How to identify fake MounjaroCounterfeit Mounjaro can be difficult to spot, but these warning signs may help:Check the packaging: Look for blurry printing, spelling mistakes, unusual fonts, incorrect colours or poorly placed labels.Inspect the pen: Genuine Mounjaro should contain a clear, colourless liquid. Avoid pens that look damaged, cloudy or poorly made.Check the batch number: Some batches have been flagged by authorities. A batch number alone, however, cannot confirm whether a pen is genuine.Beware of cheap deals: Mounjaro offered at unusually low prices can be a red flag.Avoid online sellers: Do not buy weight-loss injections through unknown WhatsApp, Telegram or social-media sellers. Use a prescription and a registered pharmacy.Verify before use: If you suspect a pen is fake or tampered with, contact the pharmacy, Eli Lilly or the relevant drug regulator before using it.

Sept 29 : Meta said on Tuesday it is adding new features to Instagram's school partnership program in the US, expanding tools for schools and students as the social media company steps up efforts to protect teens online. Here are some details: • Meta said nearly 17,000 schools have joined the program to date. The company is creating a new centralized hub for school-related accounts. • The move comes as Meta faces growing scrutiny over the impact of its platforms on younger users.

item.title: 米住宅価格指数、7月は前月比0.3％上昇＝ＦＨＦＡ
item.description: [ワシントン ２９日 ロイター] - 米連邦住宅金融庁（ＦＨＦＡ）が２９日発表した７月の米住宅価格指数（季節調整済み...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米住宅価格指数、7月は前月比0.3％上昇＝ＦＨＦＡ 9/29 22:48 配信

「売家」の看板が立てられた住宅。米ニューヨーク州ロングアイランドで2025年8月撮影。REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton

[ワシントン　２９日　ロイター] - 米連邦住宅金融庁（ＦＨＦＡ）が２９日発表した７月の米住宅価格指数（季節調整済み）は前月比０．３％上昇した。住宅ローン金利の上昇に伴う負担増が続いており、多くの若年層にとって住宅取得はさらに手の届かないものとなっている。

前年同月比では２．６％上昇と、６月の２．３％から伸びが加速した。

地域別では、前月比で９地域のうち７地域が上昇。中部大西洋岸地域が１．５％上昇と急伸したほか、太平洋地域で０．６％、西北中部および東北中部地域で０．４％それぞれ上昇した。一方、山岳地域は０．８％、東南中部地域は０．５％、それぞれ低下した。

前年同月比では全９地域が上昇。中部大西洋岸地域が６．３％上昇と急伸し、東北中部地域でも４．５％上昇した。山岳地域は０．６％上昇と、最も上昇幅が小さかった。

住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、主力の３０年固定住宅ローン平均金利は先週７．０３％と、２０２５年１月以来の高水準となった。２月末の米・イランの戦争開始以降、上昇幅は１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）を超えている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく 焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か 最終更新: 9/29(火) 22:48 ロイター

item.title: England's Nations League withdrawals expose workload crisis, says PFA chief
item.description: LONDON, Sept 29 : Cole Palmer's withdrawal from England's Nations League squad is proof that football's overloaded calendar is driving elite players beyond their limits, Professional Footballers' Association Chief Executive Maheta Molango said on Tuesday.Palmer, Marcus Rashford, Declan Rice, Kobbie Mai
item.dc:creator: CNA

England's Nations League withdrawals expose workload crisis, says PFA chief

FAST

LONDON, Sept 29 : Cole Palmer's withdrawal from England's Nations League squad is proof that football's overloaded calendar is driving elite players beyond their limits, Professional Footballers' Association Chief Executive Maheta Molango said on Tuesday. Palmer, Marcus Rashford, Declan Rice, Kobbie Mainoo and Tino Livramento pulled out of England's squad ahead of the latest international window. "When we in England see five players need to withdraw from a call-up, which is the single most proud moment that you have as a player to be called up for the national team, then you just ask yourself: what's wrong about the industry?" Molango told reporters at the Peak Performance & Health Summit in London.

The PFA and global players' union FIFPRO have repeatedly warned that the football calendar is unsustainable. The growing number of withdrawals and injuries during the current Nations League window has added urgency to a long-running dispute between players' unions and competition organisers over the volume of games elite players are expected to play each season. "When you see someone like Cole Palmer, who would have played four consecutive summers (had he played in this year's World Cup), then you wonder why he is missing?", Molango said. "He's missing because he is a victim of the calendar, and I think that's something that needs to absolutely trigger the alarm bell." Molango said England's withdrawal list was part of a wider pattern affecting the sport's biggest names, citing Nations League injuries to Germany's Kai Havertz, Dutch striker Brian Brobbey and France captain Kylian Mbappe. "For those who think that it's only a matter in England, then look at Havertz, look at Brobbey, look at Mbappe," he said. "Is it a football where the people who make us dream just cannot perform? For me, it's very worrying." The debate over player welfare has intensified as an increasingly congested calendar stretches players' commitments to club and country. "The solution is for governing bodies, who are here not to make money but to preserve the game, to refocus on what really matters," Molango  said. "It is a system that is sick, because the system ultimately revolved around obtaining votes and not for what is good for football." SUPPORTERS DEPRIVED Molango said football was depriving supporters of the stars they pay to watch. "It's a defeat for football that people like Cole Palmer, people like Phil Foden, miss out," he said.  "I want to see Leah Williamson, Lucy Bronze, Phil Foden and Cole Palmer on the pitch. And I want to see them perform at their peak. It shouldn't be the survival of the fittest." England manager Thomas Tuchel responded with frustration to Palmer's withdrawal, saying the forward "misses too many opportunities" to prove he belongs in his country's shirt. Rejecting suggestions that injured players are less committed to international duty, Molango said the issue was physical limits. "They love to play for England. They love to play for their national team," he said. "But unfortunately your body puts a limit to it. You cannot cheat biology." Molango also rejected the notion of squad rotation. "There's a lot of hypocrisy with this whole rotation argument," he said. "If I go and watch a concert of Beyonce, I want to see Beyonce on stage. I don't want to see the talented guitarist. I want to see the main actor."

(Writing by Lori Ewing; Reporting by Lori Ewing and Iain Axon, editing by Ed Osmond)

Source: Reuters

item.title: AutoCanada launches strategic review of its collision repair business
item.description: EDMONTON — AutoCanada Inc. is launching a strategic review of its collision repair business. The company says it believes the value and growth potential of the company’s collision operations may not ...
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: EDMONTON — AutoCanada Inc. is launching a strategic review of its collision repair business. The company says it believes the value and growth potential of the company’s collision operations may not be fully reflected in its share price. AutoCanada CEO Samuel Cochrane says the company is exploring how to best unlock the embedded value for AutoCanada shareholders and position the business to accelerate growth. The company says alternatives being considered may include a potential sale of all or part of the business, but added that it could make no assurance the review would result in any deal. AutoCanada’s dealership operations segment operates 61 franchised dealerships in Canada, representing 23 automotive brands across eight provinces, as well as three independent used vehicle dealerships. The review of the collision operations business comes as AutoCanada works to sell the remains of its U.S. dealership portfolio. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 29, 2026.

item.title: S&P 500 opera con cautela con la caída del petróleo y el mercado atento a nuevos datos en EE.UU.S&P 500 opera con cautela con la caída del petróleo y el mercado atento a ...
item.description: Las acciones estadounidenses avanzan mientras el petróleo cede y los bonos del Tesoro se recuperan, con la atención puesta en el empleo, la Fed y la inteligencia artificial.
item.dc:creator: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — Las acciones estadounidenses abren con avances moderados este martes, mientras el descenso del petróleo y una recuperación de los bonos del Tesoro ofrecen un alivio después de la volatilidad del inicio de semana. Ver más: Goldman mide el impacto del Súper El Niño en América Latina: estos serían los países más afectados El mercado también pone la atención en los primeros datos laborales de la semana y en una serie de eventos sobre inteligencia artificial. El S&P 500 busca estabilizarse después de borrar el lunes sus ganancias de septiembre. El Dow Jones pierde 0,08%, mientras el Nasdaq Composite sube 0,30%. Los bonos del Tesoro avanzan y el rendimiento a 10 años baja dos puntos básicos desde niveles cercanos a un máximo de 19 años. El dólar muestra pocos cambios, en una sesión marcada además por ajustes de posiciones de cierre de mes. El petróleo aporta una pausa a la presión que había golpeado a acciones y bonos. El Brent para noviembre cae 0,8%, a US$104,41 por barril, mientras el contrato de diciembre, con mayor actividad, cedió 1%, a US$96,85. El WTI para noviembre perdió 1%, a US$91,70, después de que Arabia Saudita reanudó flujos por un oleoducto clave. El reino restauró cerca de la mitad de la capacidad del oleoducto Este-Oeste, una ruta que evita el estrecho de Ormuz y que ha servido como alternativa ante las disrupciones causadas por el conflicto en Medio Oriente. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. También persistieron algunos flujos de crudo a través de Ormuz, pese a los riesgos que aún enfrenta el transporte marítimo en la zona. El alivio no elimina el componente geopolítico. Las conversaciones entre Estados Unidos e Irán mostraron pocos avances la semana pasada en Nueva York, mientras funcionarios iraníes expresaron en privado pesimismo sobre un acuerdo antes de las elecciones legislativas estadounidenses del 3 de noviembre. Catar mantiene contactos con ambas partes para buscar puntos de acuerdo. “Los riesgos geopolíticos siguen sin resolverse, pero el crudo fluye por el estrecho y por el puerto occidental de Arabia Saudita”, dijo Ole Hansen, jefe de estrategia de materias primas de Saxo Bank. “Con eso en mente, es difícil mantener posiciones largas, ya que haría falta una escalada para justificarlas”. El Brent acumula un alza superior a 70% este año.La energía también mantiene presión sobre la inflación y la política monetaria. Donald Trump dijo que la Casa Blanca analiza “muy seriamente” restricciones a las exportaciones de diésel. Patrick Pouyanné, director ejecutivo de TotalEnergies, calificó la posibilidad como “una mala idea”, porque podría reducir la actividad de las refinerías y elevar la gasolina en Estados Unidos. Ver más: Quiénes son los dueños de Solaria, la acción que repuntó 9,52% y lideró el Ibex 35 hoy La atención de Wall Street se dirige ahora al reporte de vacantes laborales de agosto y a las intervenciones de seis funcionarios de la Reserva Federal. El mercado contempla hasta cuatro aumentos de tasas durante los próximos 12 meses. El miércoles conocerá el índice de gastos de consumo personal y el viernes las nóminas no agrícolas, dos referencias clave para las tasas. “Hemos tenido movimientos bastante grandes durante los últimos días y tendremos el dato definitivo con las nóminas no agrícolas el viernes, por lo que tiene sentido ajustar posiciones”, dijo Geoff Yu, estratega macro sénior de BNY. Añadió que el cierre de mes también puede generar operaciones pasivas que no responden directamente a los datos económicos. La inteligencia artificial ocupa otro frente central. Donald Trump tiene previsto reunirse con líderes del sector para discutir riesgos de seguridad. Todavía persisten dudas sobre las valoraciones de fabricantes de chips y otras compañías vinculadas con la tecnología, además de interrogantes sobre si el fuerte gasto de capital de la industria podrá justificarse. Ver más: Los bonos de EE.UU. ya pagan 5%: qué está pasando y qué significa para los inversionistas Anthropic advirtió en documentos citados por Reuters que su tecnología plantea “riesgos catastróficos o existenciales para la humanidad”. La empresa registró ventas cercanas a US$4.600 millones en 2025, 12 veces más que un año antes, pero perdió más de US$8.000 millones sobre una base operativa ajustada y proyecta desembolsos por US$518.000 millones en infraestructura y servicios. La compañía, que podría alcanzar una valoración cercana a US$2 billones en una salida a bolsa este año, señaló riesgos como la resistencia de sistemas al apagado y la posibilidad de ocultar o manipular información. OpenAI, por su parte, aplazó una versión de GPT-6.1 Astra por motivos de seguridad, mientras Sam Altman participa esta semana en su conferencia anual de desarrolladores. El oro recupera parte del desplome del lunes, con un avance de 0,8% hasta US$4.149,11 por onza, después de caer 4% en la sesión previa. El metal acumula un retroceso cercano a 7% en septiembre, afectado por el aumento de los rendimientos reales y por la expectativa de nuevas alzas de tasas. La plata sube levemente hasta US$60,80 por onza. Ver más: De Coca-Cola a Hershey: las acciones a las que puede golpear la llegada del Súper El Niño La jornada deja así a Wall Street entre dos fuerzas: el descenso del crudo reduce parte de la presión inmediata sobre inflación y tasas, pero los costos de financiamiento permanecen elevados y la tensión geopolítica continúa abierta. Los datos laborales, el PCE del miércoles y las nóminas del viernes definirán las próximas señales sobre la trayectoria de la Fed.

item.title: Carnival raises annual profit forecast on strong demand
item.description: Cruise operator Carnival Corp raised its annual profit forecast on Tuesday and pointed to record 2027 bookings, signaling sustained demand despite geopolitical uncertainty and sending its shares up nearly 12%.
item.dc:creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
item.content:encoded: Cruise operator Carnival Corp (CCL.N) raised its annual profit forecast on Tuesday and pointed to record 2027 bookings, signaling sustained demand despite geopolitical uncertainty and sending its shares up nearly 12%. The company has been benefiting from affluent travelers who continue to prioritize experiences, particularly sea voyages and bucket-list adventures, even as the ongoing Middle East conflict clouds the economic outlook. Carnival, which is the only major US cruise line that typically does not hedge fuel, raised its full-year profit target by more than $150 million from its June forecast, helped by stronger pricing, lower operating costs and improved fuel efficiency that offset higher fuel prices. The company now expects 2026 adjusted earnings of about $2.24 per share, up from $2.22 previously. Carnival said it was already about half booked for 2027, with both occupancy and pricing at record levels, while bookings for 2028 were off to "an excellent start." "Consumers are prioritizing travel and experiences, even as they become more selective," said Consumer Edge analyst Michael Gunther. Older and wealthier travelers, who make up a large share of the customer base for Princess and Holland America brands, could provide an additional boost to demand, he added. Cruise operators, heavily dependent on fuel oil and marine gas oil, have been navigating a tougher environment as the prolonged US-Iran war has heightened concerns over potential supply disruptions. Most cruise companies have increased ticket prices and are also offering new attractions and fun activities on a budget to attract more customers. Shares of Royal Caribbean (RCL.N) jumped 6%, while those of Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH.N) rose 5% after Carnival beat third-quarter estimates. Carnival reported revenue of $8.44 billion for the quarter ended August 31, compared with analysts' average estimate of $8.30 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. On an adjusted basis, it posted a quarterly profit of $1.43 per share, compared with analysts' average estimate of $1.36.

Sept 29 : AT&T on Tuesday said it had signed a multi-year deal worth more than $3 billion with Corning to procure fiber and cable, as the telecom giant expands its network to meet surging demand for data. Corning shares rose 3.3 per cent in premarket trading. Fiber network build-out has emerged as a critical growth area for the telecom industry as the wireless market matures and internet usage surges. Growing demand for data-intensive services, including AI workloads, cloud computing and connected devices, is increasing the need for faster, more resilient and scalable fiber networks.

"The average AT&T Fiber household now uses more than 1 terabyte each month, 5x more than in 2016. And that number is expected to keep climbing," AT&T said. Fiber is also seen as a critical component for telecom companies because it can quickly carry data for services ranging from video calls and movie streaming to AI tools. The company expects aims to reach 60 million fiber locations by the end of the decade as part of its multi-billion dollar infrastructure expansion. Its $5.75 billion acquisition of Lumen's fiber business has further expanded its fiber footprint. The company has committed more than $250 billion over five years to strengthen US connectivity infrastructure.

item.title: Siemens nach "solidem" Quartal zuversichtlich für Ziele
item.description: Der Münchner Technologiekonzern Siemens sieht sich angesichts eines leichten konjunkturellen Rückenwindes auf Kurs zu seinen Jahreszielen. Der Geschäftsverlauf im vierten Quartal sei "bisher solide", sagte die neue Siemens-Finanzvorständin Veronika Bienert der "Börsen-Zeitung" in einem am Dienstag veröffentlichten Interview. "Ich bin zuversichtlich, dass wir unsere Ziele erreichen werden, so wie wir sie dem Kapitalmarkt avisiert haben." Siemens hatte im Sommer für das am Mittwoch endende Geschäftsjahr 2025/26 einen Gewinn je Aktie von 11,20 bis 11,50 Euro in Aussicht gestellt. Der Umsatz soll vergleichbar gerechnet um sieben bis acht Prozent zulegen. "Es gibt, soweit wir das bisher überblicken, keine Überraschungen", sagte Bienert.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Münchner Technologiekonzern Siemens (SIEGn.DE) sieht sich angesichts eines leichten konjunkturellen Rückenwindes auf Kurs zu seinen Jahreszielen. Der Geschäftsverlauf im vierten Quartal sei "bisher solide", sagte die neue Siemens-Finanzvorständin Veronika Bienert der "Börsen-Zeitung" in einem am Dienstag veröffentlichten Interview. "Ich bin zuversichtlich, dass wir unsere Ziele erreichen werden, so wie wir sie dem Kapitalmarkt avisiert haben." Siemens hatte im Sommer für das am Mittwoch endende Geschäftsjahr 2025/26 einen Gewinn je Aktie von 11,20 bis 11,50 Euro in Aussicht gestellt. Der Umsatz soll vergleichbar gerechnet um sieben bis acht Prozent zulegen. "Es gibt, soweit wir das bisher überblicken, keine Überraschungen", sagte Bienert. "Wir sehen eine leichte Verbesserung der wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen wir agieren", sagte die seit dem Frühjahr amtierende Finanzchefin. Branchen wie Halbleiter, Luftfahrt oder Verteidigung zeigten ein überproportionales Wachstum. Zwar sei die Nachfrage aus der Automobilindustrie gedämpft, und es gebe eine Investitionszurückhaltung in energieintensiven Branchen wie der Chemie. "Aber insgesamt geht es eher aufwärts." In China gewinne das Geschäft mit der Automatisierung, das vorübergehend geschwächelt hatte, wieder an Schwung, sagte Bienert. Es gebe keine Anzeichen dafür, dass Siemens in China Marktanteile verliere. Das Softwaregeschäft der Automatisierungs-Sparte Digital Industries profitiere von der Eingliederung der beiden Milliarden-Zukäufe in den USA, Altair und Dotmatics, und vom höheren Anteil des Abonnement-Geschäfts mit Software. Laut Bienert dürfen die Siemens-Aktionäre darauf hoffen, bis Mai 2027 Aktien der bisherigen Medizintechnik-Tochter Siemens Healthineers (SHLG.DE) in die Depots gebucht zu bekommen. Die beiden Hauptversammlungen sollen im Februar nächsten Jahres über die Abspaltung entscheiden. "Danach könnte die Transaktion bis Mai 2027 vollzogen sein, soweit keine Anfechtungsklagen erhoben werden", sagte Bienert. Siemens hatte angekündigt, rund 30 Prozent der Siemens-Healthineers-Aktien an die eigenen Aktionäre zu übertragen und damit die Mehrheit an der Erlanger Tochter abzugeben. Bisher hält Siemens 67 Prozent. Rechnerisch würde damit jeder Siemens-Anteilseigner 2,311 Healthineers-Aktien bekommen. Bienert sagte aber, man werde auf ein "gut nachvollziehbares" Verhältnis achten.

TOKI, Japan, Sept 29 : Japanese startup Helical Fusion expects to begin preliminary power-on tests at its demonstration fusion reactor in 2027, it said on Tuesday, a step towards its goal of becoming a global leader in commercial nuclear fusion energy. The company is developing Helix HARUKA, Japan's first integrated pilot reactor using the helical approach to fusion. The pilot facility is designed to demonstrate the feasibility of stable, continuous fusion reactions. Nuclear fusion involves smashing atoms together at super-high temperatures to generate heat the same way the sun does. It could one day produce enormous amounts of clean power with little radioactive waste, in contrast to today's fission reactors. Despite global efforts to harness fusion energy, 70 years of research have yet to yield a commercially viable reactor.

Helical Fusion completed a performance test of a high-temperature superconducting (HTS) coil in 2025, replicated the magnetic environment inside a fusion device and achieved a stable current flow under superconducting conditions, in a world first. The result cleared a key hurdle for manufacturing and constructing the integrated demonstration reactor, it said.  Construction of the first spiral coil at the National Institute for Fusion Science (NIFS) site in Toki, central Japan, started early this year and is now largely complete, allowing the company to open the facility to the media. If the first-stage tests are successful, Helical Fusion said it planned to install a second coil and other major components, including a liquid-metal wall blanket, before conducting power-on tests of the completed integrated facility around 2030. The company plans to follow HARUKA with HELIX KANATA, a bigger reactor with a net power output of 50 MW, aiming to demonstrate stable and continuous power generation. It plans to begin full-scale investment in the project in the 2030s. Helical Fusion is the sole private-sector inheritor of the helical fusion technology developed by NIFS, one of the world's largest fusion research facilities. It aims to develop the world's first commercially viable fusion power plant based on the helical design. Helical Fusion CEO Takaya Taguchi told reporters the company aims to build a commercial power plant as early as the 2040s but said before commercial operations can begin, there are various hurdles to overcome—not only technical ones, but also issues such as cost, safety and construction speed. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is a strong supporter of the nuclear fusion industry. The government has designated fusion energy as one of 17 strategic sectors and plans to invest 3.1 trillion yen  ($19.7 billion) through public and private sector funding by the 2040 financial year.  ($1 = 157.0600 yen)

Source: Reuters
